stories.title: Bolivia detiene a su fiscal general en operativo con apoyo de EU; lo acusa de proteger a narcos

en.title: Bolivia detains its attorney general in operation with EU support; accuses him of protecting drug traffickers
en.summary: Bolivia's attorney general was detained in an operation reportedly supported by the European Union, with accusations that he protected narcotics traffickers.

stories.title: Bolivia detiene a fiscal general y a otras personas vinculadas a organización criminal

en.title: Bolivia detains attorney general and other people linked to criminal organization
en.summary: Bolivia's attorney general Roger Mariaca was arrested along with other officials, days after the United States restricted entry to authorities over suspected corruption and drug trafficking links.

stories.title: Vinculan a proceso al excomisario de Seguridad Pública de Juchitán; presuntamente brindó protección a “Los Cromos”

en.title: Former Public Security Commissioner of Juchitán linked to process; allegedly provided protection to "Los Cromos"
en.summary: Jhon Keny Moreno Segura, a former public security commissioner, faces legal proceedings on allegations that he provided protection to a criminal group known as "Los Cromos".

stories.title: Netanyahu: copiloto de flydubai pasó por "adoctrinación islamista radical"

en.title: Netanyahu: Flydubai copilot underwent "radical Islamist indoctrination"
en.summary: The captain and passengers on a Flydubai flight subdued a copilot and prevented the aircraft from crashing, according to Netanyahu's characterization of the incident.

stories.title: Lanza SpaceX tripulación a Estación Espacial Internacional

en.title: SpaceX Launches Crew to International Space Station
en.summary: SpaceX transported four astronauts to the International Space Station, where they will live and work for approximately six months.

stories.title: NASA y SpaceX lanzan misión a la Estación Espacial Internacional; buscan lograr el viaje más rápido de una nave de EU al laboratorio

en.title: NASA and SpaceX Launch Mission to International Space Station; Aiming for Fastest US Spacecraft Journey to the Laboratory
en.summary: NASA and SpaceX launched a mission to the International Space Station with the goal of achieving the fastest journey time for a US spacecraft to reach the facility.

stories.title: Corte Suprema revisará política de Trump sobre detención obligatoria de migrantes; decidirá si puede arrestarlos sin derecho a fianza

en.title: Supreme Court to Review Trump Policy on Mandatory Detention of Migrants; Will Decide if He Can Arrest Them Without Right to Bail
en.summary: The Supreme Court will examine Trump's mandatory migrant detention policy and determine whether authorities can arrest migrants without providing them bail eligibility.

stories.title: Netanyahu dice que copiloto de avión que fue desviado tuvo "adoctrinación islamista radical"; buscan condecorar a pasajeros

en.title: Netanyahu Says Copilot of Diverted Plane Had "Radical Islamist Indoctrination"; Seeks to Honor Passengers
en.summary: Netanyahu attributed the diversion of an aircraft to the copilot's alleged radical Islamist indoctrination and indicated efforts to recognize the passengers' role.

stories.title: Trump asegura que lamenta haber nombrado a jueces de la Corte Suprema Gorsuch, Barrett y Kavanaugh

en.title: Trump says he regrets appointing Supreme Court judges Gorsuch, Barrett and Kavanaugh
en.summary: Donald Trump expressed regret over his appointments of three Supreme Court justices: Neil Gorsuch, Amy Coney Barrett, and Brett Kavanaugh.

stories.title: Rachel se intensifica a huracán categoría 2 en el océano Pacífico; pronostican lluvias muy fuertes en BCS, Sinaloa y Jalisco

en.title: Hurricane Rachel intensifies to Category 2 in the Pacific Ocean; forecasters predict heavy rainfall in BCS, Sinaloa and Jalisco
en.summary: Hurricane Rachel strengthened to Category 2 over the Pacific Ocean, with forecasters warning of heavy rainfall expected across three Mexican states.

stories.title: Huracán Rachel se intensifica a categoría 2; generará lluvias muy fuertes en 4 estados

en.title: Hurricane Rachel intensifies to Category 2; will generate heavy rainfall in 4 states
en.summary: Hurricane Rachel reached Category 2 intensity early Thursday and is moving west-northwest at 9 kilometers per hour toward Mexican states.

stories.title: Evoluciona 'Rachel' a huracán categoría 2 en el Pacífico

en.title: Hurricane 'Rachel' evolves to Category 2 in the Pacific
en.summary: Hurricane Rachel intensified to Category 2 status in the Pacific Ocean south of Cabo San Lucas, Baja California Sur.

stories.title: Sofipos quieren el mercado de pagos que todavía domina el efectivo

en.title: Financial payment companies seek market still dominated by cash
en.summary: Sofipos aim to expand digital transaction services to small merchants and consumers still relying on cash payments under new upcoming regulations.

stories.title: Producción petrolera de Pemex se desploma a su mes más bajo desde que se tiene registro

en.title: Pemex crude oil production plummets to lowest month on record
en.summary: Pemex crude production in August declined 2.7% compared to the same period last year, marking the lowest figure in the company's database.

stories.title: La ley de catastro mejorará finanzas de municipios y respetará su autonomía, asegura Hacienda

en.title: Cadastre law will improve municipal finances and respect their autonomy, says Finance Ministry
en.summary: Mexico's Finance Ministry stated that a cadastre law initiative would direct all resulting revenue to municipal treasuries while maintaining local government autonomy.

stories.title: Termina la huelga en el Monte de Piedad, ¿cuándo abre y qué pasará con los empeños de los clientes?

en.title: Strike at Monte de Piedad ends, when will it reopen and what happens to customers' pawned items?
en.summary: A strike at Nacional Monte de Piedad concluded on September 30 following months of negotiations between the institution and its union.

stories.title: La aportación del ISR a los ingresos del gobierno disminuye por tercera vez y reporta su menor nivel desde 2021

en.title: Income tax contribution to government revenue declines for the third time and reaches its lowest level since 2021
en.summary: Mexico's federal income tax collection has fallen to its lowest point since 2021 for the third consecutive period, reflecting weak economic growth and reduced tax enforcement revenue.
